## Details

### work-graph.ready

List work items with no unresolved dependency, ordered for pickup.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `scope`
- Outputs: `items`
- Fallback: `work-graph-links-fallback`

### work-graph.plan

Order work items for sequential pickup, using dependency links when available.

- Status: optional
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `scope`
- Outputs: `items`, `orderingSource`, `dependencyAware`
- Fallback: `work-graph-links-fallback`

### work-graph.graph-health

Report dependency-graph health signals (for example cycles, stale blockers).

- Status: optional
- Side effect: no
- Inputs: `scope`

- Fallback: `work-graph-links-fallback`
